novel_features.name: Aggregator-vs-direct cross-check
novel_features.description: Compare DoYouSpain's cheapest offer for a supplier against that supplier's own booking site, side by side.
novel_features.rationale: Requires correlating an aggregator result with a live direct-supplier quote in one call — no site or API does this.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this to confirm the aggregator price is real before booking, the way a careful renter double-checks the company directly.

novel_features.name: Price drift over time
novel_features.description: Show how a saved Malaga search's cheapest full-insurance price has moved across your local snapshots.
novel_features.rationale: Requires a local time series of the same search; DoYouSpain only ever shows the current price.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this to decide whether to book now or wait, based on the actual trend not a guess.

novel_features.name: Price-drop watch with target
novel_features.description: Re-quote a saved search and exit 0 when the cheapest full-insurance price is at or below your target, 10 otherwise.
novel_features.rationale: Cron-friendly re-quote loop with typed exit codes and local snapshots; replicates AutoSlash for the Spanish market, which has no such tool.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this in a cron job to get alerted the moment a tracked Malaga rental drops to your price.

novel_features.name: Cheapest-pickup-date sweep
novel_features.description: Fan out searches across a date window for a fixed rental length and rank pickup dates by cheapest total.
novel_features.rationale: No single DoYouSpain call spans multiple pickup dates; only a local fan-out with a shared store can rank them.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when your dates are flexible and you want the cheapest day to start the rental.

novel_features.name: Saved searches
novel_features.description: Name and store a recurring Malaga search so watch and drift can re-run it.
novel_features.rationale: The site is stateless per query; named searches live only in the local SQLite store.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this to set up the searches that feed watch and drift.

novel_features.name: Supplier price summary
novel_features.description: One line per supplier — Delpaso, Record Go, Wiber, Sixt and the rest — each with its cheapest full-insurance offer, ranked.
novel_features.rationale: Requires local aggregation across the parsed result set to collapse many offers into a per-supplier cheapest.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this to see which of your usual companies is cheapest today without scrolling every offer.

narrative.headline: Watch Málaga car-rental prices the way you already do — DoYouSpain's cheapest supplier, cross-checked direct, always with full insurance — now in one command with local price history and drop alerts.
narrative.value_prop: Rental Car Spain searches DoYouSpain (the aggregator that surfaces the cheapest rental companies in an area) and quotes every price with the Full Insurance / Zero Excess tier by default. It cross-checks Delpaso's own site with 'compare', tracks prices over time with 'drift', and alerts on drops with 'watch' — the AutoSlash workflow, for Spain, that no other tool offers.
narrative.auth_narrative: No account or API key needed — both sources are public sites. Rental Car Spain sends a plain (non-browser) User-Agent because DoYouSpain's WAF rejects spoofed Chrome clients; 'doctor' verifies this is working.

quickstart.comment: Confirm both sources are reachable and the WAF-safe User-Agent is set.
Resolve a place name to a DoYouSpain code (Malaga Airport = MAL02).
Search Malaga Airport for a week in August, cheapest full-insurance offers first.
See the cheapest offer per supplier, including Delpaso, Record Go and Wiber.
Cross-check the aggregator's Delpaso price against Delpaso's own site.

troubleshoots.fix: Run 'rentalcarspain-pp-cli doctor'; if DoYouSpain returns HTTP 406 the User-Agent was spoofed as a browser — Rental Car Spain must send a plain UA.
DoYouSpain dates are dd/mm/yyyy, e.g. 20/08/2026, not ISO.

troubleshoots.symptom: Record Go or Wiber missing from results
troubleshoots.fix: They appear as suppliers within 'search'/'suppliers'; there is no standalone recordgo/wiber command (Record Go geo-blocks and Wiber requires a browser).

narrative.when_to_use: Use Rental Car Spain when renting a car in Malaga (or elsewhere in Spain) and you want the cheapest full-insurance price, want to track it over days, or want to confirm an aggregator price against the supplier directly. It is built around the workflow of watching DoYouSpain and booking with Delpaso, Record Go or Wiber.
anti_triggers: Do not use it to actually book or pay for a rental — it quotes prices only.
Do not use it for flights or hotels — it is car rental only.
Do not expect live standalone Record Go or Wiber quotes — those come through the DoYouSpain aggregator.

recipes.explanation: Re-quotes a saved search; exits 0 when at or below 250 EUR so cron can notify you.

recipes.explanation: Returns only the fields an agent needs from a large result set.
